scales.name: major
scales.description: The standard major scale (do-re-mi); bright, stable, and the bedrock of Western tonal music.

scales.name: dorian
scales.description: A minor mode with a bright raised 6th; the hopeful, jazzy minor of folk and modal jazz.

scales.name: phrygian
scales.description: A minor mode with a flat 2nd; dark and tense, with a Spanish/flamenco undercurrent.

scales.name: lydian
scales.description: A major mode with a raised 4th; dreamy, floating and luminous, a film-score favorite.

scales.name: mixolydian
scales.description: A major mode with a flat 7th; the dominant-7th sound of blues, rock, funk and Celtic music.

scales.name: natural minor
scales.description: The standard minor scale and relative minor of the major scale; wistful and melancholic.

scales.name: locrian
scales.description: A diminished mode with flat 2nd and flat 5th; unstable and rarely a tonic, home of the m7b5 chord.

scales.name: harmonic minor
scales.description: Natural minor with a raised 7th, adding a strong leading tone and a dramatic augmented-2nd step.

scales.name: melodic minor
scales.description: Natural minor with raised 6th and 7th; smooths melodies to the tonic and is the parent scale of much jazz.

scales.name: dorian b2
scales.description: The 2nd mode of melodic minor; dorian brightness over a phrygian flat-2nd, restless and exotic.

scales.name: lydian augmented
scales.description: The 3rd mode of melodic minor; a lydian scale with a raised 5th, shimmering and unresolved.

scales.name: lydian dominant
scales.description: The 4th mode of melodic minor: a dominant scale with a raised 4th, matching the natural overtone series.

scales.name: mixolydian b6
scales.description: Mixolydian with a flat 6th; a dominant scale that leans melancholy, good moving to minor.

scales.name: locrian #2
scales.description: The 6th mode of melodic minor; locrian with a natural 2nd, the smoothest scale for m7b5 chords.

scales.name: altered
scales.description: The 7th mode of melodic minor; packed with every altered tension (b9 #9 #11 b13) for maximally tense dominants.

scales.name: harmonic major
scales.description: Major with a flat 6th; blends major brightness with a touch of minor shadow and an augmented-2nd step.

scales.name: phrygian dominant
scales.description: The 5th mode of harmonic minor; a major 3rd over a phrygian b2, the sound of flamenco and Klezmer.

scales.name: double harmonic
scales.description: Two augmented 2nds give this scale a vivid Middle-Eastern/Byzantine character.

scales.name: hungarian minor
scales.description: Harmonic minor with a raised 4th; the gypsy-minor scale with two dramatic augmented 2nds.

scales.name: hungarian major
scales.description: A bright, fiery scale opening on a raised 2nd and carrying a flat 7th; rooted in Hungarian folk music.

scales.name: neapolitan minor
scales.description: Harmonic minor with a flat 2nd; somber and exotic, resolving with a strong leading tone.

scales.name: neapolitan major
scales.description: Melodic minor with a flat 2nd; smooth and slightly unusual, major on top of a phrygian start.

scales.name: persian
scales.description: A flat-2nd, flat-5th scale with two augmented 2nds; intensely ornamental and Middle-Eastern.

scales.name: ukrainian dorian
scales.description: Dorian with a raised 4th; plaintive and folk-like across Eastern European and Klezmer music.

scales.name: enigmatic
scales.description: Verdi's invented scale mixing whole tones with leading tones; strange, bright and unresolved.

scales.name: major pentatonic
scales.description: A five-note major scale with no semitones; open, singable and consonant in any combination.

scales.name: minor pentatonic
scales.description: The five-note minor scale at the core of blues, rock and pop soloing.

scales.name: blues
scales.description: Minor pentatonic plus a chromatic 'blue note' (b5); the gritty, vocal sound of the blues.

scales.name: major blues
scales.description: Major pentatonic with an added b3 blue note; bright yet bluesy, common in country and rock.

scales.name: egyptian
scales.description: A suspended-sounding mode of the major pentatonic built on stacked 4ths and 5ths; open and unresolved.

scales.name: whole tone
scales.description: Six notes a whole step apart; dreamlike and rootless with no leading tone, beloved by Debussy.

scales.name: augmented
scales.description: A six-note symmetric scale alternating minor 3rds and half steps; stark and built from two augmented triads.

scales.name: diminished whole-half
scales.description: An eight-note symmetric scale alternating whole and half steps; played over diminished-7th chords.

scales.name: diminished half-whole
scales.description: The octatonic scale starting with a half step; the go-to choice over dominant 7b9/#9 chords.

scales.name: prometheus
scales.description: Scriabin's six-note 'mystic' scale built from the mystic chord; hovering, ambiguous and tense.

scales.name: messiaen mode 3
scales.description: Messiaen's third mode of limited transposition: nine notes, only four transpositions; luminous and chromatic.

scales.name: messiaen mode 4
scales.description: Messiaen's fourth mode: two chromatic clusters a tritone apart; six transpositions, hushed and mysterious.

scales.name: messiaen mode 5
scales.description: Messiaen's fifth mode: a sparse six-note subset of mode 4; stark and bell-like.

scales.name: messiaen mode 6
scales.description: Messiaen's sixth mode: whole tones with added semitones, repeating at the tritone; bright and unstable.

scales.name: messiaen mode 7
scales.description: Messiaen's seventh mode: ten notes repeating at the tritone; dense, iridescent harmony.

scales.name: bebop dominant
scales.description: Mixolydian plus a passing major 7th; the extra note keeps chord tones on the beat in fast bebop lines.

scales.name: bebop major
scales.description: The major scale with a passing b6 (#5); aligns chord tones to strong beats over major harmony.

scales.name: spanish 8-tone
scales.description: An eight-note flamenco scale extending phrygian dominant with chromatic passing tones for both 3rds.

scales.name: hirajoshi
scales.description: A Japanese pentatonic with two semitone steps; sparse, dark and contemplative on koto and shakuhachi.

scales.name: in sen
scales.description: A dark Japanese pentatonic built on the flat 2nd; haunting and traditional.

scales.name: iwato
scales.description: A somber Japanese pentatonic with two tritone-flavored tensions; tense and shadowy.

scales.name: kumoi
scales.description: A Japanese pentatonic with a bright opening and minor color; delicate and evocative.

scales.name: yo
scales.description: A bright, semitone-free Japanese pentatonic used in folk songs and Buddhist chant.

scales.name: balinese pelog
scales.description: A five-note scale approximating Indonesian gamelan pelog tuning in 12-tone equal temperament; exotic and uneven.

scales.name: chromatic
scales.description: All twelve semitones; not a tonal scale but the complete palette for passing tones and atonal writing.

chords.name: major
chords.description: The bright, stable major triad: root, major 3rd, perfect 5th.

chords.name: minor
chords.description: The dark, sad minor triad: root, minor 3rd, perfect 5th.

chords.name: diminished
chords.description: A tense triad of stacked minor 3rds (minor 3rd plus flat 5th) that wants to resolve.

chords.name: augmented
chords.description: An unstable, symmetrical triad of stacked major 3rds (major 3rd plus sharp 5th); dreamlike.

chords.name: power chord
chords.description: Just the root and 5th, no 3rd; neither major nor minor, the staple of rock and metal.

chords.name: suspended 2
chords.description: A suspended triad replacing the 3rd with the 2nd; open and unresolved.

chords.name: suspended 4
chords.description: A suspended triad replacing the 3rd with the 4th; tense, wanting to fall to the major 3rd.

chords.name: major 6
chords.description: A major triad plus the 6th; sweet and nostalgic, common in jazz and swing.

chords.name: minor 6
chords.description: A minor triad plus a major 6th; bittersweet, a favorite in jazz and bossa nova.

chords.name: dominant 7
chords.description: A major triad plus a flat 7th; restless and bluesy, the engine of tension and release.

chords.name: major 7
chords.description: A major triad plus a major 7th; lush, warm and dreamy.

chords.name: minor 7
chords.description: A minor triad plus a flat 7th; smooth and mellow, the workhorse of jazz and soul.

chords.name: minor major 7
chords.description: A minor triad with a major 7th; haunting and noir, famous from spy and horror themes.

chords.name: diminished 7
chords.description: Four stacked minor 3rds; fully symmetrical, maximally tense and endlessly modulating.

chords.name: half-diminished
chords.description: A diminished triad plus a flat 7th; the classic ii of a minor key, darker than m7 but softer than dim7.

chords.name: augmented 7
chords.description: A dominant 7th with a raised 5th; an altered dominant that pulls hard toward resolution.

chords.name: augmented major 7
chords.description: A major 7th with a raised 5th; shimmering and unstable.

chords.name: dominant 7 flat 5
chords.description: A dominant 7th with a lowered 5th; whole-tone flavored and tense.

chords.name: dominant 7 sus 4
chords.description: A dominant 7th with a suspended 4th instead of the 3rd; a soulful, delayed resolution.

chords.name: dominant 7 sus 2
chords.description: A dominant 7th with the 2nd in place of the 3rd; airy and open.

chords.name: add 9
chords.description: A major triad with an added 9th and no 7th; bright and colorful.

chords.name: minor add 9
chords.description: A minor triad with an added 9th; wistful and modern.

chords.name: add 4
chords.description: A major triad with an added 4th; lush and gently clashing, unlike sus4 which omits the 3rd.

chords.name: six nine
chords.description: A major 6th chord with an added 9th; a rich, stable jazz ending chord.

chords.name: minor six nine
chords.description: A minor 6th with an added 9th; smooth and sophisticated.

chords.name: dominant 9
chords.description: A dominant 7th extended with the 9th; funky and full.

chords.name: major 9
chords.description: A major 7th extended with the 9th; rich, open and lush.

chords.name: minor 9
chords.description: A minor 7th extended with the 9th; warm and soulful.

chords.name: dominant 7 flat 9
chords.description: A dominant 7th with a flat 9th; dark and tense, resolving strongly to minor.

chords.name: dominant 7 sharp 9
chords.description: A dominant 7th with a sharp 9th; the gritty 'Hendrix chord' clashing major and minor 3rds.

chords.name: dominant 7 sharp 11
chords.description: A dominant 7th with a raised 11th; lydian-dominant color, bright and edgy.

chords.name: major 7 sharp 11
chords.description: A major 7th with a raised 11th; the floating, modern 'lydian' chord.

chords.name: dominant 11
chords.description: A dominant 9th extended with the 11th; usually voiced without the 3rd, giving a suspended feel.

chords.name: minor 11
chords.description: A minor 9th extended with the 11th; spacious and modal, a quintessential modern-jazz minor sound.

chords.name: dominant 13
chords.description: A dominant chord extended to the 13th; full and brassy, the lush dominant of big-band jazz.

chords.name: major 13
chords.description: A major 7th extended to the 13th; maximally lush and resolved.

chords.name: minor 13
chords.description: A minor 7th extended to the 13th; deep, warm and modal.
